name: manus
label: Manus
description: AI-powered automation and task execution platform

token.label: API Key
token.description: Your Manus API key from https://app.manus.ai/settings/api-keys

create_task.label: Create Task
create_task.description: Create a new task for Manus AI to execute

prompt.label: Prompt
prompt.description: The task prompt or instruction for the Manus agent

agentProfile.label: Agent Profile
agentProfile.description: The AI model profile to use for the task

taskMode.label: Task Mode
taskMode.description: The interaction mode for the task

connectors.label: Connectors
connectors.description: List of connector IDs to enable for this task

hideInTaskList.label: Hide in Task List
hideInTaskList.description: Whether to hide this task from the Manus webapp task list

createShareableLink.label: Create Shareable Link
createShareableLink.description: Whether to make the chat publicly accessible to others on the Manus website

locale.label: Locale
locale.description: Your default locale that you've set on Manus (e.g., "en-US", "zh-CN")

attachments.label: Attachments
attachments.description: Array of file/image attachments (URLs or base64 data)

get_task.label: Get Task
get_task.description: Retrieve detailed information about a specific task by its ID

taskId.label: Task
taskId.description: Select the task to retrieve details for

update_task.label: Update Task
update_task.description: Update a task's metadata such as title, sharing settings, and visibility in the task list

enableVisibleInTaskList.label: Visible in Task List
enableVisibleInTaskList.description: Whether the task should be visible in the task list

delete_task.label: Delete Task
delete_task.description: Permanently delete a task by its ID. This action cannot be undone.
